item.title: Sample post: style check
item.description:
This post exists to check the stylesheet. It is removed when the migrated posts arrive. Every element a post may contain appears once below, so a single page shows whether the design holds.

A second-level heading

Body text is set in Nunito Sans at 18 pixels on a 30 pixel line, held to 65 characters. Links look like this, and inline code like tools/build.mjs.

  • An unordered list item.
  • A second item, long enough to wrap onto a second line at phone width so the indent can be checked.
  1. An ordered step.
  2. Another step.

A third-level heading

// A C# snippet, highlighted by Prism in the browser
public sealed class SubscriptionHandler : ICommandHandler<Subscribe>
{
    public async Task Handle(Subscribe command, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var plan = await _plans.FindAsync(command.PlanId, ct);
        if (plan is null) throw new NotFoundException("plan");
        _audit.Write($"subscribed {command.PatientId}");
    }
}
node tools/check.mjs && node tools/build.mjs
